text: I really like this app. its minimal and does what is needed from a productivity gamified app and there is no subscription model for all of this? How crazy is that. my only beef is that i have to go out of my way to allocate stat points to the character. it would be better if there was no attribute like strength, wisdom etc in the app. switching from a mage class to warrior class or vice versa suddenly would not feel like having a broken character with poorly allocated stat points then.
author: Panda Walker
developer_reply:
​Hi! Thanks for the great review! We avoid restrictive subscriptions to offer the best experience. ⚔️

​Regarding stat points, we're refining our game balance to make character growth smoother and more rewarding.

We'll keep your ideas in mind! Happy questing! 😊
